On a peaceful session, rules for the planners
This section explains the steps for the whole desk
Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

The purpose of this section is to keep pet travel clear, calm, and safe for every team member and every traveler. The desk checks each request as shared work, from the first note to the final handoff, so nothing important is missed.

Start with a complete review of the booking file and the animal details. Match the traveler record, route, and cabin limits before you promise anything. If the paperwork is thin, pause the process and ask for what is missing. Keep the tone simple and steady, because the traveler should feel that the desk is in control and paying attention.

When a pet is accepted, record the needs in the service log and pass the note to the right support staff. Make sure crate checks, medical notes, and document reviews all stay aligned with the journey. If a pet shows signs of stress, slow the pace and move the case to the senior coordinator at once. Do not guess, and do not leave a gap for the next shift to solve later. Small errors in this work can become big delays at the skyport.

Treat each handoff with care. Confirm that the traveler understands the next step, that the pet is ready for transfer, and that the desk file reflects the latest decision. Be direct, polite, and brief. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is not a place for loose talk or casual assumptions. It is a service desk, and every action should support a safe trip.

If you need help with an unusual case, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor right away.
